result:
These queries are guesses. The page names almost none of the verbs I use (`filter`, `sortBy`, `groupBy`, `frequencies`, `entries`, `lines`, `split`, `join`, `round`, `default` and so on). I couldn't check that any of them exist, so each query follows the `|`, `*` and `/k` forms the page describes and assumes verb names that seem natural.

L1: filter (/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (/qty | mul (/price | default 0)) | sum) | sum | round 2
L2: filter (/state | eq "open") * (/labels | default []) | flatten | frequencies
L3: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flatten | filter (/1 | startsWith "^0.") * /0 | distinct | sort
L4: /data/users | filter (/active | eq true) | filter (/email | ne null) * (/email | lower) | distinct | sort
L5: /services | entries | filter (/1/enabled | default true | eq true) | filter (/1/port | ne null) * {:name /0 :port /1/port} | sortBy /port
L6: lines * split " " | filter (/2 | eq "GET") | filter (/3 | eq "200") * (/4 | replace "ms" "" | toNumber) | avg | round 1
L7: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter (/2 | ne "") * {:dept (/1 | lower) :s (/2 | toNumber)} | groupBy /dept * (* /s | avg | add 0.5 | floor)
L8: * /user | frequencies | entries | sortBy [(/1 | neg) /0] | take 3 * ([/0 /1] | join ":")
L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," * trim * lower | distinct | sort | join "|"
L10: lines * trim | filter (ne "") | filter (startsWith "#" | not) | filter (contains "==") * split "==" * [(/0 | lower) /1] | fromEntries
L11: filter (/state | eq "open") | filter (/assignee | eq null) | sortBy [(/comments | neg) /number] | take 2 * /number
L12: * /customer | frequencies | entries | filter (/1 | gte 2) * /0 | sort
L13: /data/users | groupBy (/address/country | default "unknown") * (* /name | sort)
L14: filter (/type | eq "push") | filter (/payload/repo/name | ne null) * /payload/repo/name | distinct | sort
